cam.privacy: Your video stays on this phone. Only your exercise scores are shared with your physiotherapist.
cam.safety: Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or numbness.
cam.safety_cg: Stop if they feel sharp pain, dizziness or numbness.
cam.stand_back: Stand 2–3 metres back so your whole body is visible.
cam.stand_back_cg: Stand them 2–3 metres from the phone so their whole body is visible.
cam.denied_body: RecoverLens needs the camera to see your movement. To allow it:
cam.denied_chrome: Chrome / Android: tap the lock or camera icon in the address bar → Permissions → Camera → Allow.
cam.denied_safari: Safari / iPhone: tap “aA” in the address bar → Website Settings → Camera → Allow.
cam.notfound_body: Connect a camera, or open RecoverLens on a phone, then try again.
cam.insecure_body: Browsers only allow the camera on https:// pages (or localhost). Open the deployed HTTPS link instead.
cam.error_body: Close other apps that may be using the camera, then try again.
sum.title: SESSION COMPLETE
share.title: RecoverLens session
rec.torso_lean: Keep your torso upright. Try the movement standing with your back near a wall.
rec.asymmetry: Slow down so both sides move together.
rec.elbow_bend: Keep your elbows straight through the whole movement.
rec.back_arch: Tighten your stomach muscles to stop your back arching.
rec.knee_valgus: Keep your knees in line with your toes.
rec.weight_shift: Spread your weight evenly over both feet.
rec.heel_rise: Keep your heels on the floor; ankle mobility work may help.
rec.pelvis_drop: Keep your hips level; hip strengthening may help.
rec.not_high_enough: Work towards the full range, staying within a pain-free range.
guided.explain: A single camera cannot measure this movement reliably, so RecoverLens guides you with a timer instead.

obsrec.valgus: Consider hip abductor and gluteal strengthening (e.g. FIFA 11+ single-leg stance and squat exercises).
obsrec.lean: Consider ankle mobility work and core/posterior chain strengthening (e.g. FIFA 11+ Bench/Sideways Bench series).
obsrec.asymmetry: Consider unilateral strength assessment and single-leg balance training (FIFA 11+ Single-Leg Stance series).
obsrec.heel: Consider calf and ankle mobility exercises before progressing to jump/plyometric work.
obsrec.fifa_valgus: FIFA 11+: Squats (With Toe Raise → One-Leg Squats) and Single-Leg Stance.
obsrec.fifa_balance: FIFA 11+: Single-Leg Stance series and Sideways Bench.
obsrec.fifa_landing: FIFA 11+: Jumping (Vertical Jumps) focusing on soft, knee-over-toe landings.
obsrec.fifa_core: FIFA 11+: The Bench and Sideways Bench series.
